## Why visit

A Bury beer destination whose relevance is backed by the local branch's 2026 town Pub of the Year result. Brewsmith runs this friendly centre bar, normally offering a balanced pale, session and dark-beer selection across its own and guest casks. It is a better brewery-beer companion to Trackside than an undirected Bury crawl, and worth considering if a tram outing suits your dates.

## Beer

Six changing cask ales, usually four Brewsmith and two independent guests, with dark stout among the styles.

**Named changing/house breweries:** Brewsmith.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA lists weekday and weekend opening, and music on some weekends. The 2026 branch award is for Bury, not for Greater Manchester overall.

**Getting there:** Central Bury, close to the Metrolink/bus interchange and the East Lancashire Railway station.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
